caption: The video captures a person with a top-knot hairstyle and white t-shirt seated behind a dark tray. They hold a stainless-steel gooseneck kettle raised and tilted in their right hand, its spout hovering over a black conical pour-over dripper. The dripper rests on a glass server set atop a small scale. To the left sits a glass of dark brewed coffee with a light foam head, and to the right a copper-colored cup. A black microphone edge intrudes at the left frame border against a plain beige wall. Throughout the excerpt the kettle stays in a nearly constant tilted position, with no large repositioning or lifting away visible. The person's mouth repeatedly opens and closes and shifts shape, consistent with continuous speech. Their eyes look downward toward the dripper and intermittently blink, with small changes in head tilt. The coffee bed, the server's liquid level, the tray objects, and the background remain visually stable, consistent with a stationary camera and no obvious pan or zoom.
relations: The tilted gooseneck kettle remains suspended over the dripper, maintaining its angle without large repositioning.
The person's mouth opens and closes in speech while their eyes look downward at the dripper.
The coffee bed and the liquid level in the glass server remain visually stable.
The glass of brewed coffee and copper cup on the tray stay stationary throughout the excerpt.
